purpose: Separate materially distinct microscopic and collective sectors before any family-level reduction, exclusion or sufficiency claim.

branches.material_feature: Lie-group field data plus gauge/geometric/simplicity structure chosen so perturbative Feynman amplitudes reproduce named spin-foam/lattice-gauge gravity amplitudes.
Second-quantized graph-changing/Feynman-complex sum extends beyond one fixed simplicial complex while retaining explicit spin-foam amplitude ancestry.

Tensor-invariant interactions and renormalization/thermodynamic flow add collective field-theoretic structure. Some models encode quantum geometry/spin-foam data; others are structural RG testbeds and must not be called physical gravity automatically.
Macroscopic collective/condensate state of a declared microscopic GFT parent, with relational observables and effective GR/cosmology limits.
Tensor/combinatorial degrees of freedom without the Lie-group geometric data that make a GFT amplitude a spin-foam amplitude.
branches.known_scope_warning: Generic leading melonic/tree-like limits can fall in branched-polymer universality; this is not promoted to a family-wide FAIL because enhanced/nonmelonic interactions and geometric TGFT data can change the universality class.
